_meta.description: Mi Speaks reads articles, books and PDFs aloud in twenty-eight neural Studio Voices generated entirely on your iPhone. Offline, private, and the spoken word highlighted on the page it came from.
_title: Mi Speaks — Neural voices that read anything aloud, on your iPhone

mi-speaks-can-read.079199: Mi Speaks can read any written content including text you type, content from other apps, text extracted from images, and PDF files. Perfect for articles, documents, emails, books, and more.
mi-speaks-reading-on.d8e697: Mi Speaks reading on Apple Watch, the spoken word highlighted
mi-speaks-reads-a.2ea59c: Mi Speaks reads a PDF's own table of contents, or finds the headings from the page layout. Skip chapters right from the lock screen.
mi-speaks-reads-articles.d6e43e: Mi Speaks reads articles, books and PDFs aloud, word by word, entirely on your iPhone.
no-every-voice-system.4a3674: No. Every voice, system and Studio alike, runs on your device, and Mi Speaks has no account to sign in to. If you turn on Premium's library sync, your saved speeches travel through your own iCloud Drive — Apple's, not mine. I never see them.
paste-text-share-from.f6d439: Paste text, share from any app or photograph a page. Reading is free, any length, with no time limit.
premium-adds-the-twenty.d4eb83: Premium adds the twenty-eight neural Studio Voices, an unlimited library of saved speeches synced across your devices via iCloud Drive, audio export to a file, and Turbo playback speeds. It is sold monthly ($4.99), yearly ($39.99), or as a one-time lifetime purchase ($99.99). Free is not time-limited and has no length limit: any text, any system voice, three saved speeches.
reading-is-free-with.dab2cd: Reading is free with no time limit. Premium is an optional in-app purchase, with a 7-day free trial.
studio-voices-are-neural.3f3a44: Studio Voices are neural voices: instead of stitching together recorded fragments, an eighty-two-million-parameter model generates the waveform from the text, which is why the phrasing and breath sound human. The model and its voice packs are about 325 MB, downloaded once over Wi-Fi and then kept on the device. Nothing is sent anywhere afterwards — or during, beyond fetching the files themselves.
text-ready-to-be.8934ad: Text ready to be read aloud, with import tools above and the player below

what-are-studio-voices.a8efa6: What are Studio Voices, and why is there a download?

yes-mi-speaks-is.888a80: Yes. Mi Speaks is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers.
yes-tap-prepare-full.918c5a: Yes. Tap Prepare Full Document and every sentence is rendered up front, so a Studio Voice reads to the end with the screen locked, in another app or on a flight. Anything not yet prepared is read in your system voice, so the reading never stops.
your-place-follows-you.aa3b11: Your place follows you to Apple Watch. With Premium, an in-app purchase, documents prepared on iPhone play there in the same Studio voice.
